name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. '_1e' is the dispatch-table index (slot 0x1E; xref site 0x51c09 = 0x51b91 + 0x1E*4), a meaningful domain ID, not an address residue. Descriptor corrected from '__unref_major_cinematic' to '__ch9_laiting_defeat': the slot is LIVE, reached via the ch9 kill-drop path -- ch9 char_spawn_record[0] = 萊汀 (the boss, 禁衛軍隊長, enemy_data 50, char_id 0x76, lv18) carries pickup_kind=2 param=0x1E, so 萊汀's death dispatches consequence[0x1E]. The body is the 萊汀-defeat turning-point cinematic (revive 萊汀 as a 1-HP ally + plot reveal + reinforcement kickoff). The earlier 'unref' verdict only scanned turn-event/tile-step hooks and missed the kill-drop path (even though the notes correctly listed fd2_process_battle_drop_entries as one of the 3 dispatchers).
purpose: Chapter 9 萊汀-defeat turning-point cinematic (dispatch slot 0x1E, reached via the ch9 kill-drop path when the boss 萊汀 record[0], pickup_kind=2 param=0x1E, falls): clears AI bytes for a char band, schedules two future turn events (arming the ch9 reinforcement state machine), spawns NPC/ally 萊汀 (char_id 6) at 1 HP, plays a 2-page dialog (萊汀 reveals 葛雷's plot) with a portrait swap, resets pending XP, and consumes tile-event slot 0x10 with value 2.
logic_summary: 1) for i in 0x0C..0x21 (22 slots): runtime_char[i].combat_aux_block[0xD]=0 (clear AI/sub-state byte). 2) Schedule two future turn events: *(tile_event_data_table+3)=(uint8)(turn_counter+1), *(tile_event_data_table+6)=(uint8)(turn_counter+2) (trigger-turn byte of table entries +3 and +6, 3-byte stride). 3) Configure runtime_char[0x0B] on the NPC/ally side: flags=0 (revive if dead), team=1 (npc), portrait_id=6, char_id=6 (=萊汀), combat_aux_block[0x0A]=0xFF, combat_aux_block[0x0D]=0x80 (AI byte, locked bit7), hp_current=1. 4) display_dialog_scene(page 2); load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(1); display_dialog_scene(page 3). 5) pending_xp_credit=0. 6) tile_event_consumed_flags[0x10]=2 (distinct from the '1' written by other handlers). Single branch = the AI-clear loop; no RNG, no numeric computation, no CALL-return value used.

params.semantics: Uniform 1-arg cdecl dispatch slot argument from the per-event handler table at 0x51B91. The body never reads it (cast to void); kept for the uniform table calling convention.
params.reason: Accurate generic name matching every sibling handler's unread dispatch arg; no address residue, not param_N. Body ignores it, so a more specific name is not warranted.

The Ghidra plate already documented team=1 correctly as the ally side. Fixed the src wording to 'on the NPC/ally side (team=1)' and named the spawned character 萊汀 (char_id 6, portrait_id 6).
